tools.name: company_brief
tools.description: Paid $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base). One call to research a company: everything domain_enrich returns (socials, email provider, SPF/DMARC, DNS provider, RDAP age, tech stack, SaaS signals) plus its homepage and About page as clean Markdown.

tools.name: page_extract_batch
tools.description: Paid $0.008 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Extract up to 10 public web pages in parallel to clean Markdown + metadata. Per-URL errors are inline; fails (not charged) only if no URL succeeds.

tools.name: domain_enrich
tools.description: Paid $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Domain, URL or work email to a company profile from public sources: name, description, logo, social profiles, homepage contact emails/phones; email provider from MX, SPF/DMARC policy; DNS provider; SaaS signals from TXT verifications; RDAP registrar, creati

tools.name: page_extract
tools.description: Paid $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown plus metadata: title, description, canonical, language, author, dates, OpenGraph/Twitter card, JSON-LD types, headings outline, favicon, feeds, link counts (links=true for the list). Hono

tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.description: Paid $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Before your agent pays an unknown x402 endpoint: fetch its 402 unpaid and check the asset is canonical Circle USDC for that network, price/scheme/timeout sanity, and payTo (contract or EOA, USDC balance on Base). Returns verdict ok/caution/block with per-op

tools.name: usdc_payment_check
tools.description: Paid $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Verify a Base mainnet transaction paid native Circle USDC (not bridged USDbC) to a recipient, with minimum amount and confirmations. Use before releasing goods or marking an invoice paid. Verdict paid/not_paid/not_found.

tools.name: token_check
tools.description: Paid $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Before accepting, swapping or approving a token on Base: is it a contract, ERC-20 metadata, canonical official deployment (USDC, EURC, WETH, cbBTC...), impersonation of a major symbol, upgradeable proxy and admin type, owner, paused. Verdict canonical/ok/ca

tools.name: basename_resolve
tools.description: Paid $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Resolve a Basename (alice.base.eth) to its Base address, or an address to its primary Basename with forward-verification. Use before sending funds to a name.

tools.name: wallet_snapshot
tools.description: Paid $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base). One call: ETH and canonical Base token balances (native USDC, USDbC, EURC, WETH, cbBTC, cbETH, DAI, USDT), nonce, EOA or contract, flags (fresh/unused address, holds bridged USDbC). Use before sending funds or accepting a counterparty.

tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Paid $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base). State not_found/pending/success/reverted, block, confirmations, from/to, fee in ETH (incl. L1 fee), method selector, decoded ERC-20 Transfer events with symbols/amounts (canonical tokens flagged). Use to confirm a payment, swap or call landed.

tools.name: sample_report
tools.description: Free: real live x402 preflight of a fixed sample endpoint and a token check of USDC on Base, same shapes as the paid tools.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: page_extract · Private data: domain_enrich, token_check, wallet_snapshot, tx_status, sample_report · Public sink: company_brief, domain_enrich, basename_resolve.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: page_extract · Private data: domain_enrich, token_check, wallet_snapshot, tx_status, sample_report · Public sink: company_brief, domain_enrich, basename_resolve

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
